div.l: Bolde was hur fase . fayre and Rody of hewe
Sche was a worthy woman̄ all hur lyve
Husbondes at the church dore had sche had fyve
With oute oþer company in youthe
But þerof nedeth not to speke as nowth
Thryes had sche ben̄ at Ierlm̄Ierusalem
Sche had passed many a straunge strem̄
At Rome had sche be and at Boloigne
In Galys at seynte Iames and at Coloigne
Sche kowde myche of wandrynge by the wey
Gat tothed was sche sothely to sey
Vp on̄ an aumbeler softely sche sate
Y wympled well and on hur hede a hatte
As Brode as ys a Boklere or a targe
A fotemantell aboute hur hyppꝰus large
And on hur feete a peyre of spurrꝰus scharp̄e
In Felawschīe well kowde sche lawgh ⁊and karpe
Of Remedyes of love sche knewe ꝑperchaunse
For sche knewe of þat arte þᵉ old daunse
¶ A Goode man also þ̉er was of relygyoun
And was a pore ꝑpersoū of A toune
But ryche he was of holy thought ⁊and werk
He was a lerned man and a clerk
That crystes Gospell trewly wold prech
Hys parysschoıı̄uns devoutely wold he teche
Benygne he was and wonder dyligent
And in adủersite full pacyent
And such was he preved ofte sythes
Full loth were hym to curse for his tythes
But Rather wold he yeven̄ oute of doute
Vn to his pore paryschoıı̄uns Aboute
Of his Offryngꝭes and his substaun̄s
